events.title: Fujitsu has a diamond-spin quantum computer working — and has not said how big it is
events.note: Tin-vacancy centres built into photonic integrated circuits, running at −271.6 °C. The temperature is the interesting number. The missing qubit count is the interesting silence.

events.title: IBM and Chicago ran a hard, encoded circuit, and certified how good the answer was
